newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - U.S. house speaker Newt Gingrich says U.S. will help defend Taiwan if communist China attacks.
Five mainland shipping companies allowed to sail directly between Taiwan and mainland China.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Limit on banks' stock market holdings to be raised to 20 percent from 15 percent.
President Lee Teng-hui to have full control over policies of national security, foreign relations and relations across Taiwan strait.
LIBERTY TIMES - Gingrich says U.S. wants to see mainland China be like Taiwan.
Ruling Nationalist Party's constitutional reform committee proposes to expand presidential power.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan eases rules on banks' investment in stock market.
Central bank to implement loan reviews after granting loans to local companies.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Banks' stock-holding cap to be raised to 20 percent of their net asset value by end-June. Domestic oil prices remain unchanged until June.
